pages.title: Neural Lattice
pages.text: Billions of photonic neurons joined into a self-organising mesh. Connections that carry useful signals strengthen and the rest fade, so the lattice learns in the same way biological brains do, only far faster. Under light it shimmers with constant, restless activity.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Photonic Neurons on their own did little. Woven through a Metamaterial Sheet and bathed in Synaptic Fluid in the Neural Synthesizer, they began to wire themselves together, and the network started to learn without instruction.
